title: Link receive rereads mutable peer identity after signature verification
description: python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py _find_sender verifies candidate.pubkey then returns the callback-owned object; receive later rereads sender.pubkey/iid for pinning, replay, and RxFrame construction. Stateful properties or concurrent forced mutation can substitute an unverified identity after the signature check. Snapshot one exact 32-byte bytes pubkey, canonicalize to a detached PeerIdentity before verification, and use only that canonical value throughout; apply the same discipline to self/rekey/local identity candidates. Add stateful-candidate, concurrent-mutation, malformed type/length, pin/replay/RxFrame binding tests.
